F1.title: Green Bond Principles (GBP)
F1.note: Four core components confirmed via ICMA's own GBP page plus consistent secondary summaries (Norton Rose Fulbright, ADB/hypo.org overviews): Use of Proceeds; Process for Project Evaluation and Selection; Management of Proceeds; Reporting. These are the same four components carried into the Blue Bond Guidance (F2) — a bond is not eligible under either framework without all four disclosed.
F1.citation: ICMA, Green Bond Principles (GBP), June 2025 edition

F2.title: Bonds to Finance the Sustainable Blue Economy: A Practitioner's Guide
F2.publisher: ICMA, International Finance Corporation (IFC), UN Global Compact, UNEP Finance Initiative, Asian Development Bank
F2.note: The primary PDF exceeds this tool's fetch size limit (>10MB) and could not be read directly. Six eligible-category names below are corroborated across secondary sources (DLA Piper's 26-Sep-2022 consultative-draft summary, plus other aggregated summaries): Sustainable Seafood, Coastal & Marine Tourism, Sustainable Maritime Transport, Marine Renewable Energy, Marine Pollution Prevention/Control, Sustainable Ports. At least one secondary source states the final guide defines more categories than these six; this register does NOT claim the six below are exhaustive. Treat category matching against this list as informational triage, not a definitive eligibility ruling — the coverage_note on every finance result says so explicitly.
F2.citation: ICMA / IFC / UNGC / UNEP FI / ADB, Bonds to Finance the Sustainable Blue Economy: A Practitioner's Guide, September 2023
